Apple (AAPL) Holder Naples Global Advisors Has Boosted Position; Westover Capital Advisors Decreased Its Holding in Marathon Pete (MPC) by $331,055 as Shares Rose
June 14, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Naples Global Advisors Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 6.84% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Naples Global Advisors Llc bought 2,639 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 41,245 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.92 million, up from 38,606 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Naples Global Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $937.81 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.05% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $190.8. About 21.48 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
